## Account Manager

### locales

`accountManager.locales`

List locales supported by DigiCert ONE Account Manager.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.digicert.api.accountManager.locales({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_

Uses the DigiCert ONE service-user token stored in `digicert_one_api_key`, sent as `x-api-key`.


**Output:** `object[]`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  code?: de_DE | en_US | es_ES | fr_FR | it_IT | ja_JP | ko_KR | pt_PT | ru_RU | zh_CN | zh_TW | string,
  language?: Deutsch | English | Español | Français | Italiano | 日本語 | 한국어 | Português | Русский | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | string
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Account Manager Api

### createAccount

`accountManagerApi.createAccount`

Create account

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.digicert.api.accountManagerApi.createAccount({
	body: {
		name: 'example',
		service_period: { to: 'example' },
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `path` | `object` | No | Defaults to &#123;&#125;. |
| `query` | `object` | No | Defaults to &#123;&#125;. |
| `headers` | `object` | No | Defaults to &#123;&#125;. |
| `cookies` | `object` | No | Defaults to &#123;&#125;. |
| `body` | `object` | Yes | — |

```ts
{
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="query full type">

```ts

}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="headers full type">

```ts
{
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="cookies full type">

```ts
{
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="body full type">

```ts
{
  name: string,
  service_period: {
    from?: string,
    to: string
  },
  is_standard_login?: boolean,
  mfa_enabled?: boolean,
  locale?: string,
  type?: standard | partner,
  partner_account_id?: string
}
```
